info.text:
The IMF says AI spending is propping up global growth.
Its October 2026 outlook: world growth 3.1% in 2026, up from 3.0% in July but below 3.5% in 2025.
It assumes oil averages $96 a barrel in 2026 and sees global inflation at 4.7%.
The US is forecast to grow 2.3%, unchanged from July.
Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook (Oct 2026), AP, Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
